contents.reason: This specific entrywise formula depends on the inner-product and real-symmetric spectral-theorem developments. Their pages are inner-product-spaces-and-orthogonality at order 94 and the-spectral-theorem-and-singular-value-decomposition at order 141, both below order 195, but neither page is published or in this pair's declared requires closure. The inner-product page is in flight as batch 3 of this run; the spectral-theorem page also requires the unbuilt the-fundamental-theorem-of-algebra and triangularisation-and-jordan-canonical-form pages. The scaffold instead retains the general trace formula under the explicit hypothesis $\chi_A(t)=\prod_{i<p}(t-\lambda_i)$ in $K[t]$, which needs no orthogonal diagonalisation. Licensing page: the-spectral-theorem-and-singular-value-decomposition (order 141).
